instructions: The state is a task brief for a coding agent. Choose the review tier this task deserves.

criteria.trivial: Comments, prose, documentation, or a config value with no branching or behavioural change; or running already-working code to produce an artifact judged by eye.
criteria.low: Docs, comments, or pure configuration with a small, well-understood behavioural effect.
criteria.normal: Ordinary feature or fix with new logic, tests, and edge cases.
criteria.critical: Core algorithms, data-loss surfaces, security or credential handling, public API shape, concurrency, or anything the user asked to treat carefully.
